Order book imbalance

Use a short observation window and document the data level. The hypothesis is that documented order book imbalance can be observed within a short window. The signals used are book imbalance and traded volume. Entry is taken when the documented imbalance condition holds. The position is exited at the end of the documented observation window. The data required is the venue market data feed. The risks noted are feed gaps and documentation drift.
